item.name: 20 thanh toán cùng lúc + GET công nợ

exec: const send = (o) => new Promise((resolve) => pm.sendRequest(o, (err, res) => resolve({ err, res })));
const r = await send({ url: fee + '/students/' + id + '/payments', method: 'POST', header: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ amount }) } });
if (!r.res) return { code: 0, ms: 0, body: null };
try { body = r.res.json(); } catch (e) { body = null; }
return { code: r.res.code, ms: r.res.responseTime, body };
const getJson = async (url) => { const r = await send({ url, method: 'GET' }); return r.res.json(); };
const workers = Array.from({ length: concurrency }, async () => {
while (next < total) { const k = next++; results[k] = await fn(k); }
const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
const f = await send({ url: fee + '/students/1/fees', method: 'GET' });
pm.test('GET công nợ trả 200 khi 20 thanh toán đang chờ', () => pm.expect(f.res.code).to.eql(200));
pm.test('20 thanh toán đều trả 504 + PENDING', () => pm.expect(results.every((r) => r.code === 504 && r.body && r.body.status === 'PENDING')).to.be.true);
pm.test('Mỗi thanh toán ≤ 4,5 giây', () => pm.expect(Math.max(...results.map((r) => r.ms))).to.be.at.most(4500));
